title: inup configuration
description: Project settings for inup (inup.config.jsonc). Every field is optional. Docs: https://github.com/donfear/inup/blob/main/docs/guide/configuration.md

$schema.description: The JSON schema for this file, so editors can autocomplete and check it. inup itself ignores it.

ignore.description: Hide these packages from upgrade checks entirely. Exact names or globs: "lodash", "@babel/*", "eslint-*" (? matches one character).

only.description: Check only these packages, as if every run named them on the command line (`inup react`). Same pattern syntax as "ignore". Packages named on the command line replace this list for that run.

ignoreMajor.description: Suppress only major updates for these packages: minor and patch updates still show, and a package whose only update is a new major counts as up to date. Same pattern syntax as "ignore".

exclude.description: Skip directories while discovering package.json files. Regular expressions, matched against forward-slash relative paths.

scanDirs.description: Scan these directory names even though they are on the default skip list (node_modules, dist, build, coverage, out, lib, es, esm, cjs). Use it when a real package lives under, say, lib/.

minimumReleaseAge.description: Supply-chain cooldown in minutes, the same name and unit pnpm uses: never offer a version published more recently than this. 0 turns it off. 10080 is 7 days.

minimumReleaseAgeExclude.description: Packages exempt from minimumReleaseAge, typically your own, which you want immediately. Same pattern syntax as "ignore".

showPeerDependencyVulnerabilities.description: Show vulnerability badges for peerDependencies in the package list.

showOptionalDependencyVulnerabilities.description: Show vulnerability badges for optionalDependencies in the package list.

concurrency.description: Pin registry-fetch parallelism (1-24) and turn off adaptive ramping, for slow or metered connections. The --concurrency flag overrides it.

native.description: Use inup's native (Rust) core to fetch and parse registry data. On by default; the first run downloads the prebuilt core for this platform once. Set false to keep native code off this project. --native and --no-native override it.

verify.patternErrorMessage: Give a command to run, such as "npm test".
verify.description: A command your upgrades must keep passing, usually your tests. After upgrading in the picker or with --apply, inup runs it and puts back each upgrade it fails with. --verify overrides it and --no-verify skips it for one run.
